limits: Same checkpoint/engines, node-local warmed file paths for every mode, current public mono loader, B1 frontend graphs;11alternating repeats. Each sample includes executor creation/join, headers, read/decode/resample and full fixed-batch corpus request; B1 is not per-utterance latency. CPU preloading only prepares reference outputs. No cold disk/Lustre/network claim. All session pools resident, not standalone VRAM; future loaded batches bounded by count not bytes. No combined frontend/mono gain claim.

whole_allocation_gpu_sampling.scope: Entire sampled allocation: includes load/JIT/capture/diagnostics/idle and all resident variant pools. Five-second utilization snapshots are not a per-variant steady-state metric or kernel wall time.
